issue.title: crashing/freezing with splits, :term and updatetime

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body:
Here is a video.
https://youtu.be/NOl_QPr8S1Q

Also I said in the video that I used `<c-c>` to close but it doesn't matter.

Reproduction steps and minimal init.vim

``` vim
set updatetime=0
nnoremap <silent> <a-v> :vsplit term://$SHELL<CR>
nnoremap <silent> <c-g> :vs term://./neogo<CR>
```

The update time value can be 1 or 0 or something above that likely but I haven't tested it fully. It doesn't happen at values like 1000 or 4000.
1. Open neovim with the provided minimal init.vim. `nvim -u init.vim`
2. Start spamming `<c-g>` and `<a-v>` to create a bunch of splits.
3. Start closing them rapidly by pressing x/`<c-c>`
4. Neovim should magically crash or freeze.
5. You may have to repeat steps 2-3 a few times.

Here are two log files with verbosity set to 15.

Crashing
https://gist.githubusercontent.com/nhooyr/10689acaf7afe919a129/raw/375161850c4b121042470b0b088f3e33b5ecbffe/nvim.log%2520crashing

Freezing (it just freezes here, its not outputting anything repeatedly)
https://gist.githubusercontent.com/nhooyr/72512de7ef5efc89562d/raw/fb9f1b51f91f7558f936349b27806bd0a515dabe/nvim.log%2520freezing

I will test different updatetime values later to get to the bottom of this. I'll update this issue as soon as I can.
